title: Getting Started with uxlearn
text: User Experience (UX) evaluation essential part designing improving digital products services. Understanding users interact interface requires collecting, analysing interpreting usability data. uxlearn R package designed support teaching learning UX evaluation. combines usability metrics, educational exercises, synthetic datasets practical case studies. package aims help students develop practical skills : Understanding usability metrics. Analysing user performance. Identifying usability problems. Interpreting quantitative results. Translating findings design recommendations. datasets included tutorial synthetic. designed educational purposes represent real users empirical research findings.

title: Getting Started with uxlearn
text: Usability metrics provide quantitative information interaction users digital products. datasets included uxlearn allow students explore four fundamental dimensions: Task success: whether users complete task successfully. Task time: long users take complete task. Errors: number errors made interaction. Satisfaction: users’ reported satisfaction. example, calculate overall task success rate: Calculate average task completion time: Calculate average errors: Calculate average satisfaction: metrics interpreted together. high task success rate necessarily imply efficient satisfactory experience.

title: Getting Started with uxlearn
text: ux_learning() function generates structured learning exercises based usability data. Exercises available three levels: Beginner. Intermediate. Advanced. example, generate intermediate exercise using e-commerce dataset: Explore task-level analysis: exercise includes quantitative results, interpretations questions designed encourage students analyse usability findings.

title: Getting Started with uxlearn
text: ux_recommendations() function transforms results learning exercise structured recommendations learning activities. Tasks assigned educational priority according observed success rate: High: 80%. Medium: 80% 90%. Low: 90% . thresholds illustrative teaching rules rather universal usability benchmarks. Students can use recommendations identify usability barriers, compare alternative design solutions propose improvements.

title: Getting Started with uxlearn
text: following activities can used university courses, workshops independent learning. Activity 1. Understanding usability Calculate task success, average completion time errors selected dataset. Explain metric reveals user experience. Activity 2. Identifying usability problems Use ux_learning() analyse dataset. Identify tasks lowest success rates discuss possible causes. Activity 3. Prioritising design improvements Generate recommendations ux_recommendations(). Justify usability problems addressed first. Activity 4. Comparing digital environments Compare four case studies. Discuss usability challenges differ e-commerce, banking, education public administration. Activity 5. Evidence-based design Propose interface improvement based observed usability results. Explain metrics used evaluate whether proposed improvement works.
